faqs.question: How do Web3 projects get funded?
faqs.answer: Options include ecosystem grants (Ethereum Foundation, L2 grants), VC funding (a16z, Paradigm), token launches (launchpads), and retroactive funding (Optimism RetroPGF).

faqs.question: What are ecosystem grants?
faqs.answer: Grants from blockchain foundations to fund development. Ethereum Foundation, Uniswap Grants, Arbitrum Foundation, and others fund projects building on their ecosystems.

faqs.question: How do I pitch to crypto VCs?
faqs.answer: Build a working product first. Crypto VCs value technical founders and open-source contributions. Network at conferences, get warm intros, and show traction metrics like TVL or users.
